surfaces.name: KanVibe Desktop (Electron, macOS dmg / Homebrew cask)
KanVibe Mobile (Flutter iOS/Android companion, source build)

claims.answer: Electron desktop app for macOS (Homebrew cask, dmg), plus a Flutter iOS/Android companion that builds from source and pairs to a running desktop; no hosted web client.

scope.plan: Open source (AGPL-3.0), local desktop with optional SSH hosts

desktop_os.answer: macOS 10.15+ dmg and Homebrew cask are the only distribution; main.js has Linux handling and docs list Linux shortcuts but no Linux installer or Windows support is published (installation page and release assets list only macOS).

mobile_apps.answer: Flutter iOS and Android app exists in mobile/ and builds from source (fvm); no store release; README calls it an early preview.

browser.answer: No hosted web client; the UI is an Electron renderer (README mentions browser/WebSocket updates but no HTTP route serves the UI). Bounded search of the pinned source found no implementation.

mobile_browser.answer: No mobile web interface; phones use the Flutter app. Bounded search of the pinned source found no implementation.

cli.answer: Per-worktree .kanvibe/task.sh (create/delete tasks) and the kanvibe.sh start/stop script; no CLI to steer sessions or review.

editor_extensions.answer: No editor extension (Monaco editor is built into the diff page). Bounded search of the pinned source found no implementation.

task_actions.answer: Desktop: create/branch tasks, drag or :move status, open terminal and type, diff view with edit, open PR URL, delete. Mobile: board, create task, change status, read terminal and send input. No approve/reject action inside the product.

notifications.answer: Desktop system notifications and in-app inbox for hook status changes, PR events and sync items; mobile inbox shares read state; background push needs Firebase/APNs plus a relay.

cross_device_continuity.answer: Phone reaches the same running terminals and board while the desktop runs and is reachable; multiple PCs can be saved; nothing runs without the desktop.

limitations: Mobile is source-build only with Korean labels and early-preview status.
Linux and Windows have no installers; Linux appears only in dev/shortcut code paths.
No browser or editor client; mobile terminals need the desktop running.

session_integration.answer: Launches the agent CLI in a tmux/zellij/Herdr/PTY terminal and observes it via hooks, transcripts and pane process inspection; no harness API embedding.

mixed_harness_operation.answer: Tasks are independent terminals; different tasks can run different CLIs and AI chat history merges four providers with provider badges.

limitations: Parts that are partial, unsupported or unknown in the scoped release: model_providers, custom_adapters; see the atomic answers.

evidence.title: KanVibe README
evidence.finding: Keyboard-first macOS Kanban workspace for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and OpenCode with git worktrees, terminals (Herdr/tmux/zellij), hooks, diff view, mobile companion, AGPL-3.0.

evidence.title: Features page (docs site source)
evidence.finding: Board, worktree view, task workspace, terminal tabs, AI chat history, live AI sessions, AI usage and accounts, quick search, notifications, hooks and mobile.

evidence.title: Installation page (docs site source)
evidence.finding: Install KanVibe Desktop on macOS with Homebrew cask; prerequisites git, gh, Herdr/tmux/zellij; mobile builds from source.

evidence.title: Mobile guide (docs site source)
evidence.finding: Flutter iOS/Android companion built from source; pairing code (6 digits, 5 minutes, single use); LAN/Tailscale reachability; foreground WebSocket; background push needs Firebase/APNs and a desktop relay.

evidence.title: Settings page (docs site source)
evidence.finding: Theme, pane layouts, detail page, task creation default session type, notifications, keyboard, background sync interval 1-1440 minutes, AI accounts.

evidence.title: AGPL-3.0 licence text
evidence.finding: GNU Affero General Public License version 3; README states AGPL-3.0 and that commercial SaaS distribution is not permitted; no or-later grant in the README.

evidence.title: Desktop package manifest
evidence.finding: version 1.5.5; Electron ^32.3.3; dist script builds electron-builder --mac dmg only.

evidence.title: Packaging config
evidence.finding: Only a mac dmg target (minimumSystemVersion 10.15.0); publish null.

evidence.title: Electron main process platform branches
evidence.finding: Linux branch disables GPU acceleration; macOS-specific menu/dock handling elsewhere; no Windows branch; packaging produces macOS only.

evidence.title: Task entity
evidence.finding: Task fields: title, description, status todo/progress/pending/review/done, branch, worktree path, session type (tmux, zellij, herdr, terminal), session name, ssh host, agent type, project, base branch, PR URL, priority.

evidence.title: Project entity
evidence.finding: Project name, repo path, default branch, ssh host, worktree flag, color, icon.

evidence.title: createTask and status updates
evidence.finding: createTask creates the git worktree and terminal session and installs hooks; updateTaskStatus and updateTask persist changes.

evidence.title: Delete and branch tasks
evidence.finding: deleteTaskAcrossTargets cleans worktree, branch and session (refuses dirty worktrees without force); branchFromTask creates a follow-up task from an existing branch.

evidence.title: Move task and PR lookup
evidence.finding: moveTaskToColumn changes status; fetchAndSavePrUrl uses gh pr list to attach a PR URL.

evidence.title: PR and pull sync
evidence.finding: syncActiveTaskPullRequests reads PR info with the gh CLI, records merged PRs; syncActiveTaskPulls runs git pull --ff-only on tracked repos.

evidence.title: Hook status service
evidence.finding: POST taskId + status (todo/progress/pending/review/done) updates the task and broadcasts; unknown task returns 404 and still notifies; tunnel-reachability check for remote hosts.

evidence.title: Hook and mobile HTTP server
evidence.finding: Routes /api/hooks/health, hook install script (token), /api/hooks/status, task CLI routes and /api/mobile/*; browser-origin rejection and remote-hook guard.

evidence.title: Hook installer
evidence.finding: Installs agent hooks for Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI and OpenCode into each worktree (.claude, .gemini, .codex, .opencode plugin).

evidence.title: Task CLI routes
evidence.finding: POST /api/cli/tasks (create), /api/cli/tasks/delete, /api/cli/tasks/register authenticated with a per-task token.

evidence.title: Task CLI service
evidence.finding: createTaskFromCli creates a new branch task and worktree in the same project (409 on duplicate branch) and propagates to peer clients; deleteTaskFromCli requires confirmed:true.

evidence.title: Worktree task.sh CLI
evidence.finding: .kanvibe/task.sh create --branch/--title/--from-task/--session-type and delete --yes [--force] against registered KanVibe clients from targets.json.

evidence.title: Mobile pairing rules
evidence.finding: Six-digit single-use code valid 5 minutes with 5 failure cap; 32-byte device tokens persisted; terminal read/write requires the token while /api/hooks/status is unauthenticated.

evidence.title: Mobile API routes
evidence.finding: REST and WebSocket routes for board, tasks, directories, project scan, notifications, notification settings, device deletion and stream/events.

evidence.title: Mobile pane write
evidence.finding: writeToPane sends input to the herdr, zellij, tmux or terminal session for a task pane.

evidence.title: Mobile TLS certificate
evidence.finding: Self-signed certificate for the mobile port; mobile pins the fingerprint at pairing (docs).

evidence.title: Mobile push relay
evidence.finding: Optional self-run relay that forwards desktop notification requests to FCM HTTP v1 with a bearer relayToken; configured via KANVIBE_MOBILE_PUSH_RELAY_URL/TOKEN.

evidence.title: Background sync
evidence.finding: While the app is open, syncs worktrees, PR state and pulls every configured interval (default 10 minutes, 20 s initial delay).

evidence.title: Diff service
evidence.finding: getGitDiffFiles, original/current content, saveFileContent (edit), task diff stats.

evidence.title: Live AI session reader
evidence.finding: Reads Claude, Codex, Gemini and OpenCode transcripts/session stores and tmux/Herdr pane processes to show running sessions and subtasks.

evidence.title: AI usage readers
evidence.finding: Reads each CLI stored sign-in and calls api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/usage, chatgpt.com wham/usage and cloudcode-pa quota endpoints to show subscription windows.

evidence.title: AI account management
evidence.finding: Creates per-account CLI home directories, launches the CLI login in an in-app terminal, removes accounts it created.

evidence.title: Release update check
evidence.finding: Checks https://api.github.com/repos/rookedsysc/kanvibe/releases (cached one hour) and shows an update dialog.

evidence.title: Worktree creation
evidence.finding: git worktree add -b <branch> <path> <base> locally or over SSH.

evidence.title: Worktree cleanup
evidence.finding: branch -D and worktree remove --force for a deleted task.

evidence.title: Git pull
evidence.finding: git pull --ff-only helper used by sync.

evidence.title: Herdr integration
evidence.finding: Herdr server/workspace/tab handling for local and SSH hosts.

evidence.title: SSH config reader
evidence.finding: Reads ~/.ssh/config hosts for remote projects and tasks.

evidence.title: Hook tunnels
evidence.finding: Reverse SSH tunnels let remote hosts post hook status to the local app; reconciled on an interval.

evidence.title: Terminal sessions
evidence.finding: Creates tmux, zellij, Herdr or direct PTY (terminal) sessions per task; terminal type is owned by the app and dies on quit.

evidence.title: Shell environment
evidence.finding: createLocalShellEnvironment strips PORT, HOST, NODE_ENV and KANVIBE_* from user shells (CLAUDE.md rule).

evidence.title: Notification store
evidence.finding: Persisted notification inbox shared by desktop and mobile (latest 100).

evidence.title: App settings entity
evidence.finding: Settings persisted in SQLite (theme, session type default, sync, notification filters, shortcuts).

evidence.title: CI workflow
evidence.finding: Type check, tests and build on PRs and pushes to main/dev.

evidence.title: Mobile developer README
evidence.finding: Flutter client (iOS and Android) that mirrors task terminal panes; build from source with fvm.

evidence.title: GitHub repository metadata
evidence.finding: 151 stars at the check; AGPL-3.0; homepage kanvibe.rookedsysc.com; default branch main; pushed 2026-11-17; not archived.

evidence.title: Release 1.5.5
evidence.finding: Published 2026-11-12 (commit b3370c4); single asset KanVibe-1.5.5.dmg; notes describe remote Herdr registration and SSH lock fixes.

evidence.title: Repository issues and PRs
evidence.finding: Recent merged work on pane chat input, mobile terminal selection, Herdr scrolling and AI usage refresh; these items postdate release 1.5.5 and are not part of the pinned source; one open issue about zellij pane chat; no roadmap.

evidence.title: KanVibe documentation site
evidence.finding: First-party docs site built from docs-site/ in the repository; same content as the MDX sources.

evidence.title: README main board screenshot
evidence.finding: First-party Kanban board screenshot used as the README hero image.

evidence.title: Bounded search: telemetry and analytics
evidence.finding: No telemetry or analytics code (hits were substrings of "SettingsEntry"); network calls are the GitHub releases check, GitHub avatar fetch, a Nerd Font CDN, provider usage endpoints for the optional usage panel and the user-configured push relay.

evidence.title: Bounded search: vendor cloud and accounts
evidence.finding: No vendor-hosted service or KanVibe account; OAuth appears only in AI-provider usage/sign-in helpers (Claude, Gemini) and the CLI sign-in terminal.

evidence.title: Bounded search: MCP, plugins, skills, scheduling, cost, review
evidence.finding: No MCP client or server (mcp only in credential key names), no skill import (the OpenCode plugin is generated for hooks), no cron or agent scheduler, no cost or budget accounting, no review approval flow; setInterval is used for tunnel reconcile, status polling, heartbeat and background sync.

evidence.title: Bounded search: roles, SSO, collaboration
evidence.finding: No roles, SSO or multi-user model; mobile devices pair to one desktop with device tokens and the notification inbox is shared per desktop.

evidence.title: Bounded search: sandboxes and containers
evidence.finding: Only the Electron Chromium no-sandbox flag for headless Linux; no container, VM or OS sandbox for agents.
